house_style: Rich handmade cut-paper and gouache storybook illustration for ages 5 to 8. Tactile paper fibers, layered edges, visible brush marks, warm light from upper left, gentle dimensional shadows, playful crafted proportions. No text, letters, numbers, logos, people or human body parts.

assets.name: theater
assets.prompt: Homemade puppet theater made from corrugated cardboard, straight-on symmetrical view. Wide rectangular stage opening occupying the central 70 percent, red fabric curtains tied at the sides, blank cardboard sign above, layered scalloped proscenium, a broad wooden cardboard ledge below. The opening and all exterior background are perfectly flat pure green #00FF00, for keying. Entire theater fully in frame. The frame should be thin enough to leave plenty of acting space.
assets.review: Inspected cutout and placement in the tool.
